title: Establish local Dashboard automation runner
prohibited_actions: No ObserverOS source, database, API, credential, media, or deployment access
acceptance: A local preflight validates the exact admitted OTP, repository remote, clean start state, and declared scope
A changed-path guard rejects paths outside an OTP allowlist and high-risk file patterns
A receipt draft command records the exact OTP SHA and checked commit without writing authoritative state
A Mock-only environment template excludes real ObserverOS, media, database, and credential configuration
All runner commands operate without network calls other than normal Git operations invoked separately
evidence_required: allowed-path positive and negative test output
